title: MusicDrop v1.5.8 Available
changelog:
• Fixed Video Mode Switching: Eliminated unrelated hardcoded video fallback (Kesariya) and prevented stale video IDs from persisting when switching tracks
• Strict Song-to-Video Match Verification: Switching from Audio to Video now verifies title/artist alignment; if no matching video stream exists, it displays an ambient audio cover screen rather than an unrelated video
• Stale Video Cache Clearance: Audio playback immediately clears past video sessions so switching to video mode never bleeds from an older session
• Seamless Video Tab Transition: Clean loading spinner and graceful audio fallback indicator
